Speech bubbles and trees no longer disappear behind the clock.

**Fixes**
- **Speech bubbles stay readable**: a bubble that drifted into the clock's area lost its text, leaving an empty frame. Bubbles (and the [E] prompts and the cocoa cabin's menu) now sit on top of every widget, so they can always be read.
- **No more holes in the scenery**: the clock kept stars and snow out from between its digits by clearing everything in its box. Moved over the big tree or a house, that cut a band out of the tree, its ornaments or the house's lights. Now it clears only stars and snowflakes, and the tree, houses and decorations show through as they should.
